archetypes.name: dyn-design-bgjob
archetypes.rationale: Changed /design prompt waits, bgjob result-env routing, and allowlist coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migrated /design final-summary and brainstorm bgjob contracts. Focus on whether every normal continuation is gated by BGJOB_RC=0 plus the required result-env KVs, and whether any stale Claude run_in_background recovery path remains live. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
